step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture depicts an automated server migration workflow from an on-premises data center to AWS. The Migration Team interacts with Slack and DynamoDB to trigger and configure migration metadata. An EC2 instance acting as the Migration Factory orchestrates calls to App Discovery Service and CloudEndure, stops replication on an EC2 Hot Replica, bakes an AMI, shares it across account boundaries, and launches the target EC2 instance. On-prem servers stream telemetry to App Discovery Service and replicate block data directly to the EC2 Hot Replica.
